verdict.rationale: Typesense documents built-in Natural Language Search and native LLM integrations for RAG, plus a dedicated MCP server that lets an AI agent create/configure clusters, build collections, index data, and tune search 'all from the conversation' — directly enabling natural-language operation of both search and admin tasks. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of natural-language search accuracy and community confirmation that the MCP-driven conversational admin flow works reliably in practice.
